intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}, and both are listed with GATE. This page compares recorded year tuitions, the placements we hold, and the ranks in our table, using official sites opened in {{year}}.

Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham vs Karunya University is a Coimbatore private-university comparison. The recorded fee heads are not built the same way, so do not add itemised Karunya rows into a total we have not confirmed.

sections.heading: Amrita vs Karunya University for M.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham if you want a GATE-listed M.Tech with recorded year tuition of ₹1.73 lakh on most computer and electronics streams, or ₹1.05 lakh for engineering design, and a NIRF 2025 rank of 23 on our records.
Choose Karunya University only after you have an official fee total, because our table stores tuition of ₹90,000 a year plus other itemised heads, and the only placement row we hold is from 2017.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Amrita we hold year tuition of ₹1.73 lakh on artificial intelligence, cyber security, data science, computer science, communication systems, embedded systems, automotive electronics, biomedical and automobile engineering.
Engineering design is recorded at ₹1.05 lakh tuition for one year. These are year tuition figures, not confirmed official programme totals.

For Karunya we hold year tuition of ₹90,000 on the listed M.Tech rows, plus separate year heads of ₹10,000 academic charges, ₹10,000 university fee, ₹10,000 security, ₹5,000 activity fee and ₹5,000 career counselling.
We have not added those Karunya heads into a programme total. Confirm the official notice on karunya.edu before you budget, and do not quote the ₹10,000 heads as the full M.Tech fee.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Amrita has a 2020 M.Tech Automotive Electronics row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹7 lakh highest. Older 2017 and 2014 rows are also stored; do not treat those years as current flagship figures.
Karunya's only M.Tech row here is from 2017, with ₹3 lakh average for aerospace engineering and no highest package recorded. That year is too old to use as a 2026 comparison.
Ask both placement cells for a later official M.Tech report before you lean on packages.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: Both are listed with GATE. Confirm each university's current official M.Tech admission note, including any institute test or GATE-qualified routes.
On our records, Amrita has a NIRF rank of 23 in 2025 and 2024, recorded against M.Tech / M.E. Karunya has no NIRF rank in our table on this page. Confirm the current list on nirfindia.org.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, and both are recorded as private universities, so a local student can visit them on the same trip.
The M.Tech branch lists are not identical. Match the exact specialisation, labs and faculty, not only the city.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Amrita if the recorded NIRF rank of 23 and the listed computer or electronics M.Tech branches fit you, after you confirm the official year tuition for that stream.
Pick Karunya if that campus and branch are the offer you have, after you have a written official fee total rather than a sum of itemised heads from our table.
Do not decide from the 2017 Karunya row or from Amrita's pre-2020 packages.

faqs.question: What M.Tech fees are on record for Amrita and Karunya?
faqs.answer: Amrita has year tuition of ₹1.73 lakh on most listed computer and electronics streams, and ₹1.05 lakh for engineering design. Karunya has year tuition of ₹90,000 plus other itemised heads. We have not added Karunya's heads into a total.

faqs.question: Are recent M.Tech placements available?
faqs.answer: Amrita has a 2020 automotive electronics row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹7 lakh highest. Karunya's only row is from 2017, with ₹3 lakh average. Ask both campuses for a later official report.

faqs.question: Which college has a NIRF rank on this page?
faqs.answer: Amrita has a NIRF rank of 23 in 2025 and 2024, recorded against M.Tech / M.E. Karunya has no NIRF rank in our table here. Confirm the official NIRF list if you need the exact listing.

faqs.question: Do both programmes use GATE?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are listed with GATE. Confirm each university's current official M.Tech admission note for any additional institute route.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Coimbatore?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham and Karunya University are recorded in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, as private universities.

faqs.question: Should I add Karunya's itemised heads myself?
faqs.answer: No. Our table stores tuition and other year heads separately, and we have not confirmed an official programme total. Use the official notice on karunya.edu.
